items.description: HD-2D Octopath Traveler style pixel art scene, the entrance of an old mana mine at night in a dark pine forest, a sturdy timber-framed mine portal cut into a mossy rock face, two brass lanterns on the posts, faint teal mana light glowing from deep inside the tunnel and seeping as mist over the ground, a mine cart rail running out of the portal, wooden crates and a water barrel beside it, fireflies and drifting mana motes, tall dark pines and layered mist behind, moonlight from above, cool blue-grey palette with warm brass lantern accents and a cold teal glow, no people, wide cinematic composition with the portal in the lower center and empty dark sky and treetops in the upper half
